idea-plugin.name: IDE Utils
idea-plugin.description:
A small collection of IDE utilities.

Included:
  • External file picker — launch any external file-picker command and open the chosen file in the IDE
  • Copy Project Root — copy the current project's root directory path to the system clipboard.
Getting started: see the project page on GitHub for setup, the picker contract, and an example picker built with broot.
